question: Which one of the following is not a feature of an Open Economy?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Restrictions on Large-scale industries**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**Open Economy**

__
 
• An open economy is one that participates in **international trade**.
 
• In an open economy,** trades involves in both the export and import of products and services in addition to conducting business within their own nation**.
 
• Due to the fact that this economy consists of the household sector, business sector, government sector, and foreign sector, it is sometimes referred to as a **"four sector economy." **
 
• In the present period, **every economy of the world is an open economy**.
 
• **Features of Open Economy:**
 
 
• An open economy has **economic relations to the rest of the globe**.
 
• A country with an open economy t**rades goods and services with other nations**.
 
• An open economy **borrows money from other nations and lends it out as well**.
 
• **Delicensing** of Industries
 
• Ordinary citizens of an open economy **are free to travel and work anywhere** they want within that **economy's domestic boundaries**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In contrast to open economy, **closed economy is entirely self-sufficient; no imports are brought in and no exports are sent out**.
 
• As the world becomes more **globally interconnected, the economy is becoming more open**.
 
• **"Open economy" **is defined by **GN Mankiw** as "an economy that freely interacts with other economies around the world."
 
• **Few examples of open economy are:**
 
 
• India
 
• Hongkong
 
• USA
 
• Finland
 
• Singapore
